top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Immunizations-Record must be on file with preK or school (26 TAC §747.623(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of four children's records reviewed was missing current immunization records.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not wash a child's hands after changing there diaper.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver went to wash the child's hands.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - No Beverages with Added Sugar, unless allowed by CACFP (26 TAC §747.3101(g))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Sugar added drink was made available to children.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when  the caregiver discarded the sugar added drink.

top_violation_types.title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Napping mats / cribs are not individually assigned and labeled with the children's names / assigned number. Mats are not marked or colored so that the sleeping side can be distinguished from the floor side.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment- Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §747.4403(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a multiple occupancy  swing on the composite play structure.

top_violation_types.title: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application (26 TAC §745.621(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection, the full background check has not been completed.
